title: TanimTech soil suitability reference
description: Advisory reference bands for screening crop fit. These records do not replace a laboratory soil test or local agronomy advice.

profiles.name: Clay
profiles.description: Fine-textured soil with high water and nutrient holding capacity; drainage is the main field check.

profiles.name: Loam
profiles.description: Balanced texture that commonly supports both water retention and root aeration when structure is maintained.

profiles.name: Sandy
profiles.description: Coarse-textured soil that drains quickly and may need closer attention to moisture, nutrients, and organic matter.

profiles.name: Silty
profiles.description: Smooth, water-holding soil that can crust or compact; surface drainage and structure deserve attention.

profiles.name: Peaty / organic-rich
profiles.description: Organic-rich soil with high water-holding capacity; acidity, subsidence, and nutrient balance should be tested.
